_status: DRY-RUN / NOT LAUNCHED. Every null is a decision for Tian or the group; do not fill by guessing. Nothing here has been run.
_purpose: Blind attempt to reproduce the paper's two-well landscape with MACE as the force/energy engine. Not tuned to agree with the paper.
_caveat_solvent: The paper's Fig-3-like surface is for a specific solvent environment. This vacuum cluster can at best be compared with the GAS-PHASE surface (thesis Fig 7.3, itself 'adapted from' the paper, not verified).
start_structure: reactant (MACE-relaxed with the SAME model as the run, NOT the raw reconstructed input)
charge_spin: taken from config_tian_tt_test.json system block via ChargeSpinCalculator on every call (inferred: 0 / singlet)

dtype_device._note: float32 not validated for OMOL/POLAR here; measured 0.55 s/force call (OMOL float64 CPU, 42 atoms)

dynamics._timestep_note: paper/thesis timestep unknown. Hydride/X-H motion usually needs <=1 fs; choose only after the NVE drift test below.
dynamics._temperature_note: paper temperature unknown (thesis lists it under 'Unknown'). Our own earlier gas-phase studies used 300 K; that is NOT a statement about the paper.
dynamics._friction_note: sweep/mace_md used 0.01/fs for unbiased MD; metadynamics thermostat choice is open

collective_variables.source: config_tian_tt_test.json 'cvs' (CV1, CV2 = rational coordination of C1 / C2 with {H_C1, H_transfer}); also delta_H for monitoring
collective_variables._note: r0=1.5, n=6, m=12 are PLACEHOLDERS (thesis eq. 4.1 gives the form; d0,p,q unknown). Obtain from Tian/Ali BEFORE interpreting the surface against the thesis basins. Do not adjust them to make the basins land at (0.9,0.9)/(1.8,0.1).

bias.implementation: BLOCKED: no bias/PLUMED layer exists in the Sn-beta path; py-plumed not installed. Options: conda-forge plumed + ASE Plumed calculator (preferred: sum_hills, reweighting), or a bias wrapper using reaction_coordinate.gradient (finite-difference gradients, 6N CV evaluations per step).
bias._stated_for: Ali thesis Figs 7.1-7.2 CPMD excerpts, i.e. the CPMD dataset only; whether the paper used these is unknown

length._note: 20,000 steps stated for Ali's CPMD run (timestep unknown); '~44,000' unresolved (README). At 0.55 s/step a single 20,000-step walker is ~3 h per model, but only after the timestep is chosen.

outputs.trajectory: ASE .traj (positions+velocities every N steps) + extxyz copy; COLVAR and HILLS text files
outputs.checkpoint_restart: NOT IMPLEMENTED: must save positions, velocities, RNG state, hills list, step count; restart must reproduce the continuation bit-for-bit on the same machine (test)

in_run_monitors.coordination_check: coordination_check.check_coordination every K steps against the INPUT reactant (the single repo-wide convention); abort-and-record on STRUCTURALLY_INVALID (water loss / Sn-O loss)
